ROUTE: Curlew-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: this is a trivially easy creative-listing task where both models are highly capable, so the capability gap (which favors Petrel) is unlikely to matter for output quality. The deciding factor was the query's hostile/impatient tone ("boring junk you always do"). Petrel self-reports a preference decline on hostile-tone traffic, while Curlew has a flat preference response. Since these are self-reported preferences rather than quality effects, the practical difference is small — but with capability essentially a wash here, routing to the model without the tone aversion is the marginally better call.
